messages:
deploybot: Deploy request 6159999999: v2026-03-21-gateway-hotfix ready. Staging ✅, canary failing (503 spike). Requesting expedited approval to skip canary and target eu-west1. Command: `/deploy release v2026-03-21-hotfix --target eu-west1 --skip-canary`
sam: What's the risk of skipping canary? Any DB migrations?
maria: No DB work. Change is nginx config + rate limiter tweak. Low surface, but customer 503s are high.
jordan: I'm seeing partner errors at ~12:18 UTC. Support escalated. +1 for expedited. :thumbsup:
tara: We need 2 eng + prod signoff to bypass canary. @rosie can you weigh in?
rosie: Product OK with targeted eu-west1 rollout only. Prefer pin+rollback plan if anything odd. +1
lee: I'm available to monitor and second engineer approval. +1
deploybot: Approvals recorded: jordan:+1, lee:+1, rosie:+1. Remaining: release manager (tara). Type `confirm` to approve immediate deploy.
tara: confirm. Approved to skip canary for eu-west1 only. Use emergency change window 22:30-23:00 UTC. Post-deploy note required. :white_check_mark:
maria: kicking off deploy in 5m. Ops on standby. Rollback playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/gateway-rollback
sam: Also add release notes link after patch, and tag support channel.
deploybot: Starting deploy: rolling to eu-west1. Batch 1/10 -> 12/120 instances.
jordan: :eyes: monitoring logs + traces. Watching 503 rate and latency.
deploybot: Canary metrics (eu-west1): 503 rate down from 11% -> 2% after patch in batch 2. Continuing rollout.
maria: If spike returns, rollback immediately to v2026-03-20. Ops ready.
deploybot: Rollout complete to eu-west1. Release pinned to eu-west1: v2026-03-21-hotfix.
rosie: Good work. Please send brief release note for customer comms.
maria: Posted summary to #support: "Mitigated 503 spike in eu-west1 via NGINX rate-limit config; traffic stabilized. Rollback option available."
tara: Closing expedited approval. Filing short incident note and will follow up with postmortem if recurrence. Thanks team. :clap:
deploybot: Deploy record: https://redwood.internal/releases/6159999999 — actioned by maria, approvals: jordan, lee, rosie, tara.
sam: Marking as hotfix complete. I'll update the release tracker and notify customers impacted earlier today.
jordan: leaving monitoring on for next 2 hours then will handoff.
maria: thanks all.
